method: Ordinary Core. Three dedicated AWS c7i.12xlarge hosts in us-east-2b, eight logical CPUs 0–7. Each trial used one host; all three worker widths for a model ran on that same host, one process at a time. For each of three trials, each model ran at one, four and eight requested workers; width order rotated 1/4/8, 8/1/4, 4/8/1. Times are elapsed GNU time seconds, RSS in KiB. Compare within the host; the original #1028 release benchmark used a differently configured bare-metal host.
command: taskset -c 0-7 dive check MODULE --config CFG --library-path modules --workers W --seed 0 --fp 0 --time-limit 3600s --max-memory 24g --output json

temporal_workers.scope: Every four- and eight-worker request reported these phases. The one-worker report omits this field. Expansion and commit timers are populated only for parallel waves.
temporal_workers.commit_ms_definition: Elapsed time on completed parallel levels less measured expansion time, through the checkpoint boundary. Includes ordered admission, graph recording and other coordination in that interval.
